title: A lightweight Python client for streaming research and charts
author: SnowSilent7695
selftext:
For the past six months or so, mcps have been the primary way I've been doing stock research and analysis. They're great in so many ways, but use up a ton of tokens. I've recently been using a lightweight python api, flexreportfinance, to do this instead. I've been mainly using it to stream the biggest gainers and losers, and then pull the latest research for a deeper dive. Figured I'd share it in case anyone is looking for a simple, real-time api, and has been scarred by high token costs.

It has an official Python repository as well as a public repo with demo notebooks to get started: [https://pypi.org/project/flexreportfinance/](https://pypi.org/project/flexreportfinance/)
